questions.q: How old was the Prophet SAW when he went to Sham with Abu Talib?
questions.explain: Abu Talib softened and let the twelve-year-old Prophet come along.

questions.q: What was Abu Talib's real name?
questions.explain: Abu Talib's real name was Abdul Manaf. He was a poor merchant.

questions.q: Who was the wife of Abu Talib who cared for the Prophet SAW like a mother?
questions.explain: Fatimah bint Asad looked after him, later embraced Islam and migrated to Madinah.

questions.q: What was the name of the caravan stop on the road to Sham where they met the monk Bahira?
questions.explain: Busra was a caravan stop on the road to Sham.

options: A monk or scholar in Busra
questions.explain: Bahira was a scholar who read the old scriptures and recognised the signs of prophethood.

questions.q: What advice did Bahira give Abu Talib?
questions.explain: Bahira advised Abu Talib not to take him on to Sham and to return to Makkah.

questions.q: Why did the Prophet SAW fall asleep when he wanted to listen to singing?
options: Because Allah protected him from what harms the heart and character
Because Abu Talib told him to sleep
questions.explain: Two nights in a row he fell asleep before he could listen. Allah protects whom He wills.

questions.q: A camel has eyelashes like wipers that protect its eyes, a sign of Allah's creation.
questions.explain: True. The ustaz invites us to observe Allah's creation, like the camel.

questions.q: All sirah scholars accept the story of Bahira without any doubt.
questions.explain: False. Some scholars doubt the story because Abu Talib did not embrace Islam. Differences of opinion exist in the sirah.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: He lives in Abu Talib's house
Abu Talib lets him come to Sham

questions.explain: He lived in Abu Talib's house, went to Sham, a cloud shaded the caravan, and Bahira invited them to eat and gave his warning.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A caravan stop on the road to Sham
The scripture given to Prophet Musa AS
The name of the final prophet announced by Prophet Isa
The northern region, direction of the summer trade journey

questions.explain: Sham is the northern region, Busra a caravan stop, the Torah the book of Prophet Musa, and Ahmad the name of the final prophet mentioned by Isa.

questions.q: You catch sight of an inappropriate picture in a magazine or a shopping centre. What should you do?
options: Cover or change it and guard your gaze
questions.explain: The ustaz teaches us to guard our gaze by covering or changing such pictures, just as the Prophet SAW was protected from such things.
